occupation_context: Assistive technology specialists configuring Talon Voice for healthcare professionals. Clinical staff use NATO phonetics in radio/emergency communication and use medical abbreviations constantly in documentation.

checks.task_design: Two-part task: overhaul phonetic alphabet (26 changes) + create new medical vocabulary list.
checks.verifier_do_nothing: Original phonetics unchanged, no medical file: score = 0, passed = False
checks.verifier_nato_only: All 26 NATO phonetics correct, no medical list: score = 60, passed = True (at threshold)
checks.verifier_both: All NATO + medical list with 8+ terms: score >= 95, passed = True
checks.verifier_partial_nato: 10/26 NATO phonetics correct: score = 20 + partial, passed = False

adversarial_robustness.wrong_header: Changing list header from user.letter costs 10 pts
adversarial_robustness.misspelled_nato: juliett vs juliet, x-ray vs xray: each wrong = -2 pts
adversarial_robustness.too_few_medical: < 8 terms: partial credit only for C4
